derived.image_up_source: north projected on the image plane (near-nadir)
derived.look_dir_source: assumed nadir (record has no center point or tilt)
notes: sun azimuth taken as degrees clockwise from north at the nadir point (Gateway convention assumed)
planet is a sphere of 6371 km; altitude added to it
look direction is NOT in the Gateway record; no scene is emitted until an owner-supplied look direction exists
sensor size (35.9, 23.9) mm from the vendor FX spec; the Gateway Format line carries none
